action.prompt: A new MDX blog post was created in firstcloudsolutions/posts/. Verify it follows the blog authoring rules: it must open with a frontmatter block between --- markers containing title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), excerpt (under ~30 words), slug, and tags (array). The slug must match the filename without .mdx and be unique across /posts/. If anything is missing or malformed, fix it and explain what you changed.
